title: 第12章 禁区的禁忌

第12章 禁区的禁忌
面对血影的挑衅，鸾牙目中杀机更强，看向雷队。
雷队神色如常，淡淡开口。
“十字。”
十字闻言二话不说直接拿起弓，瞬息拉开向着天空一箭射去。
速度之快，掀起尖锐的呼啸之音，其箭矢如一道闪电，刹那间就贯穿了天空盘旋的那只鹰。
苍穹血花绽放，此鹰发出凄厉的惨叫，坠落下来，砰的一下掉在了两个小队的中间地面上。
与此同时，血影小队里的一人，全身狂震，喷出一口鲜血，面色刹那苍白。
那是他的鹰，与鸾牙养的狗不同，这只鹰是他自身灵能融入操控，此刻反噬之下，整个人都受了重创。
血影小队其他人纷纷杀机弥漫，但被血影队长拦住，他缓缓从狗尸上站起，没去看鸾牙，而是盯着雷队。
雷队也冷眼看着他。
二人对望许久，各自冷哼。
“我们走。”雷队沉着开口，向前走去，鸾牙等人跟随在后，许青也在其中。
他感受到了两个小队之间的深深敌意，于是回头扫了眼血影小队的那些人，看出他们在等待马四与胖山，可惜，这两位永远都不会出现了。
许青默不作声，收回目光，随着雷队等人，渐渐离开了营地。
禁区距离营地看似不远，可实际上步行过去，还是有些距离。
他们一行人走了约莫半个多时辰后，才遥遥的看到那片漆黑的丛林。
从外面看去，这片禁区丛林无边无际，不知蔓延多少范围。
如今正是日上三竿之时，阳光浓郁，但禁区丛林内，似与外面是两个世界。
远远的还能看到丛林尽头的天空上，似有风暴汇聚，一道道肉眼可见的闪电，于其中耀眼出没，使整个禁区，给人一种神秘凶险之感。

许青望着这一切，默默跟随，路上雷霆小队无人说话，但随着距离禁区越来越近，许青敏锐的注意到所有人，全身肌肉都开始逐渐紧绷，他也如此。
直至那种好似踏入到了阴寒世界的感觉，浮现许青全身时，随着他身上的所有暖意被瞬间清除，他进入到了禁区内。
仿佛一同被清除的，还有他在正常世界里所看的一切画面。
熟悉的刺骨阴冷，唤醒了他曾经在废墟城池内，血雨里的回忆。
于是他深吸口气，心底的警惕强烈，手中本能的将铁签抓的很紧，与在废墟时，一样。
不同的是，城池断壁残垣，而这里……
树木扭曲如厉鬼之影，泥地枯烂若黄泉之土，枝叶弥漫似爪牙遮天。
但雷霆小队的人，显然对这里很熟悉。
他们背着兵器，所走的路明显是常走之处，每一步都很有细节，有的地方明明一切正常，他们却偏偏跳过，有的地方看似凶险，他们却踏步而行。
还有的区域，则是没来由的绕开，就这样，一路避过了一些危险所在。
许青跟随在后，密切的关注，
但他也发现了一些奇怪之处，并非全部路程都是雷队打头，有时是蛮鬼，有时是鸾牙，相互替换。
众人前行的速度虽不快，但一路上除了远远听到一些凶兽的嘶吼外，倒也还算安全。
就算是有一些毒虫，也在鸾牙点燃一根香后，没有靠近。
直至走了约莫一个时辰，全程没有任何话语的他们，在一处淤泥旁停下，彼此松了口气。
许青注意到鸾牙取出一些药粉，洒在淤泥里，很快一群毒虫从内钻出，似具备攻击性，但她神色如常，挥手间取出另一种粉末散开，毒虫躁动，很快四散，淤泥平静下来。
做完这些，众人纷纷蹲下，熟练的将淤泥捞起，涂抹全身。
“路上的细节，
许青点头，没有犹豫捞起淤泥开始涂抹，同时目光扫过鸾牙，他觉得对方似懂一些毒术的样子。
“跳过避开的地方，是因树叶枯萎严重但完整，这代表没有凶兽走过，存在未知。”

“直接踏去的区域，是因地面有凶兽粪便，而生物本能是选择安全区域排泄，所以代表不存过分的危险与吃人的泥潭。”
“至于绕开的范围，是因蛮鬼的鼻子，他鼻子灵敏，能闻到一些危险异兽存在的气味，这一路你学习的东西会很多，能记多少就记多少吧。”
许青闻言看了眼蛮鬼，蛮鬼此刻也转头，冲着许青呲牙一笑。
“至于这淤泥，是我们小队多年前发现的一处蕴含夜蜥皮损之地，涂抹全身不但能遮盖我们的气息，更有一定的威慑。”
“往前，是我们要去的方位，而向北走去，那里是毒龙潭，禁区丛林因不同的地貌，被拾荒者自发的划分了若干个范围。”
“毒龙潭就是其一，但这一次我们不去那里。”雷队话语间，已然涂抹完毕。
许青此刻已然完成，起身时，从他身边走过的十字，昨日虽质疑许青的跟随，但还是冷着脸说了一句。
“留意你的异化点，禁区内异质浓郁，要时刻注意，一旦超标异化，没人能救。”
许青点了点头，早就察觉到了这一点。
他能感受到这禁区内的异质浓度极高，但比城池废墟最巅峰时，要弱了很多。
只不过他如今自身异质累积不少，所以此刻哪怕不修炼，只是呼吸，他手臂的异化点都开始隐隐刺痛。
于是取出一枚白丹放在口中，没有吞下，而是含住让其慢慢融化。
很快，所有人都涂抹完毕，众人相互看了看，继续前行。
但与之前的路程有些不同，接下来的道路，他们的速度更慢，且每个人的手里，都将兵器取出。
许青扫过他们的兵器。
蛮鬼是精钢盾牌与狼牙棒，雷队是拳套，十字是长弓，至于鸾牙则是取出一把锯齿匕首，上面泛着寒芒。
前几天许青外出盯梢胖山，也有其他收获。
因听力敏锐，所以听到了不少拾荒者彼此的谈话，知晓了很多往日不曾知道的信息。
比如兵器这里，他如今已经知晓，分为法宝、符宝以及重宝。
其中法宝属于传说之物，颇为罕见。

传闻每一个法宝都存在不同程度的异质污染，还会随着使用而增加，极难清除，所以基本上属于是不可再生的资源，再加上威力巨大，自然异常珍贵。
于是就诞生了养宝人这一类特殊存在，他们往往都是从孩童被人圈养，以身体去稀释法宝的异质。
这一点，当初雷队也说过。
除了法宝外，再就是符宝与重宝。
前者符宝虽一样少有，但相对法宝而言，还算可以奢求之物，至于后者重宝就常见了。
往往都是一些特殊材质打造，是普通人一样可以使用的兵器。
许青觉得自己的铁签，或许就是重宝，而眼前这些人手中的，显然也是这一类。
时间慢慢流逝，许青跟随雷霆小队，渐渐在这禁区内越走越远。
途中也遇到了一些不大不小的麻烦，但大都被蛮鬼一人处理掉。
偶尔遇到强大一些的凶兽，十字的弓就会激射而出。
至于鸾牙的出手，则是以术法为主，她似乎可以进行某种震慑，使到来的凶兽出现顿住的行为，很不灵活。
期间许青也出手了一次，将一只从后方激射而来的毒蛇一把抓住，直接捏碎。
而在处理了这些，且发现前行中许青从始至终都能跟随，没有犯任何新手的错误后，十字看向许青的目光，少了一些审视，也向他传授了一些经验。
“小孩，这禁区看似凶险，但对我们这些在此地摸爬滚打的人来说，只要不遇到三种情况，基本上是安全的。”
“这三种情况，你要牢记。”
“第一种，是禁区深处的陌生异兽，来到了外围区域，这种情况不是很常见，而我们所活动的范围，实际上都是禁区外围而已。”
“可一旦遇到，就是无比凶险，因为我们只了解外围异兽的习性与能力，而禁区太大，里面的异兽多种多样，能力也五花八门，稍微一个不留神，就是死亡。”
“第二种就是歌声。“说到这里，十字脸色露出忌惮。
“此地禁区内流传着一个说法，据说在这里会出现歌声，而听到歌声的人百不存一，只不过我是从来没听到过歌声，我们里听到过歌声的，只有雷队一人。”
许青看向雷队。

雷队没说话，只是抬头看了眼禁区深处，目中隐隐有一抹复杂。
“第三种我来说吧。”一旁的鸾牙笑道，看了许青一眼。
“小孩，这里的第三种危险，很常见，那就是迷雾。”
“迷雾一出如人变瞎，必定迷路，且迷雾存在时间一般很久，而一旦在这里迷失了方向，无法及时走出，被困在禁区内，随着异质的腐蚀，自身异质自然逐渐提升，而这也往往代表了死亡的降临。
“但有两个办法可以化解，一个是火，一个则是天生或者后天所修，精神力强大者。”
“前者治标不治本，虽火可以小范围驱散雾气，恢复视力，但迷雾诡异，火难长存，至于后者，往往几十年能在营地里出现一个半个的，这一类人大都很快就离开，有更好的发展。”
“还有第四种危险，那就是遇到敌对者的恶意伏击。”在前开路的蛮鬼，闷闷的说了一句。
一旁的鸾牙刚要开口，但就在这时，看向禁区远处的雷队，忽然神色变化，低喝一声。
“收声！”
下一瞬，十字开弓，鸾牙目中露出幽芒，蛮鬼全身膨胀，许青这里也是汗毛刹那间竖起，一股强烈的威胁，在他们远处的漆黑丛林内，蓦然传来。
很快，漆黑中一道道幽芒出现，那是一双双眼睛，带着冷漠，带着阴寒，凝望众人。
眼睛极多。
而随着这些眼睛的出现，一头头全身长满黑色鳞片，身体如水牛般大小的巨狼，缓缓的走出。
放眼看去，数量至少有数十之多，甚至远处隐隐的，似乎还有更多，怕是不下数百。
而每一头狼，身上散发出的灵能波动，都达到了二层左右，使得蛮鬼等人，纷纷色变。
“黑鳞狼群！”
“它们一般只生活在禁区深处与外围的交界，不在这片范围，怎么会跑到这里来！”
十字瞳孔收缩，一旁的鸾牙也是面色有些苍白。
实在是他们很清楚，虽单独的黑鳞狼不算什么，但如此数量的话，对他们而言将是一场严峻的考验。
最重要的是禁区内异质浓郁，一旦体内灵能损耗过大，只能去吸收外界灵能补充。而战斗之余必然来不及分离异质，如此的话，体内异质将极快的累积，异化风险无限增大。

许青也呼吸微微急促，来自狼群的压迫力，极大。
“你们先撤，我来阻拦一下它们。”
在众人都心神震动中，雷队沉声开口，缓缓走出。
一股超越了十字至少一倍的灵能波动，随着雷队的前行，从其身上爆发开来。
那些狼群，也都脚步一顿，纷纷盯向雷队。
(本章完)

Chapter 12 Taboos in restricted areas
Faced with Xue Ying's provocation, Luan Ya looked at Lei Dui with more murderous intent in his eyes.
Lei Dui looked normal and spoke calmly.
"Cross."
After hearing this, Shizi picked up the bow without saying a word, drew it in an instant and shot an arrow into the sky.
The speed was so fast that it set off a sharp whistling sound, and its arrow was like a bolt of lightning, instantly piercing the eagle hovering in the sky.
Blood flowers bloomed in the sky, and the eagle let out a shrill scream, fell down, and landed on the ground between the two teams with a thud.
At the same time, a member of the Blood Shadow Team shook violently all over, spitting out a mouthful of blood, and his face turned pale for an instant.
That was his eagle. Unlike the dog Luan Ya raised, this eagle was controlled by his own spiritual energy. At this moment, his whole body was severely injured under the backlash.
The rest of the Blood Shadow Team were filled with murderous intent, but they were stopped by Captain Blood Shadow. He slowly stood up from the dog corpse, not looking at Luan Ya, but staring at Team Lei.
Team Lei also looked at him coldly.
The two looked at each other for a long time, each snorting coldly.
"Let's go." Lei Dui said calmly and walked forward, followed by Luan Ya and others, including Xu Qing.
He felt the deep hostility between the two teams, so he turned back and glanced at the people in the Blood Shadow team, and saw that they were waiting for Ma Si and Pang Shan. Unfortunately, these two would never show up.
Xu Qing remained silent, withdrew his gaze, and gradually left the camp with Lei Dui and others.
The restricted area seems to be not far from the camp, but in fact it is still quite a distance on foot.
The group of them walked for about half an hour before they saw the dark forest in the distance.
From the outside, this forbidden jungle is boundless and spreads to an unknown extent.
It is now three o'clock in the morning, and the sunshine is strong, but the jungle in the restricted area seems to be a different world from the outside.
From a distance, you can see that there seems to be a storm gathering in the sky at the end of the jungle, with streaks of lightning visible to the naked eye dazzling in and out, giving the entire restricted area a mysterious and dangerous feeling.
Xu Qing watched all this and followed silently. No one in the Thunder team spoke on the road, but as they got closer and closer to the penalty area, Xu Qing keenly noticed everyone, and the muscles all over his body began to gradually tighten, and so did he.
Until the feeling as if he had stepped into a cold world appeared throughout Xu Qing's body, as all the warmth in his body was instantly removed, he entered the restricted area.
It seemed that all the scenes he saw in the normal world were also eliminated.
The familiar biting coldness awakened his memories of being in the ruined city, amidst the rain of blood.
So he took a deep breath, the vigilance in his heart was strong, and he instinctively grasped the iron sign tightly in his hand, just like when he was in the ruins.
The difference is that the city is in ruins, but here...
The trees are twisted like the shadows of evil spirits, the muddy ground is as rotten as the soil of the underworld, and the branches and leaves are spread like claws covering the sky.
But the people in the Thunder team are obviously familiar with this place.
They carried weapons on their backs, and the path they took was obviously a well-traveled one, and every step was filled with details. They skipped some places where everything seemed normal, and walked on even though some places seemed dangerous.
There were other areas that were bypassed for no reason. In this way, some dangers were avoided along the way.
Xu Qing followed behind, paying close attention.
But he also discovered something strange. Not all the journeys were led by the Thunder Team. Sometimes it was the Barbarian Ghosts, and sometimes it was the Luan Ya who replaced each other.
Although everyone was not moving very fast, apart from hearing the roars of some ferocious beasts in the distance, it was still relatively safe.
Even if there were some poisonous insects, they did not come close after Luan Ya lit an incense stick.
After walking for about an hour, without saying a word, they stopped beside a muddy area and breathed a sigh of relief to each other.
Xu Qing noticed that Luan Ya took out some medicinal powder and sprinkled it in the mud. Soon a group of poisonous insects emerged from it, seemingly aggressive, but she looked likeChang took out another kind of powder and dispersed it with his hand. The poisonous insects were agitated and soon scattered in all directions, and the mud calmed down.
After doing this, everyone squatted down, skillfully scooped up the mud and smeared it all over their bodies.
"The details on the road,
Xu Qing nodded, and without hesitation, he picked up the mud and began to apply it. At the same time, his eyes swept over Luan Ya. He felt that the other party seemed to know some poison techniques.
"Skip over the avoided areas because the leaves are severely withered but intact, which means no evil beasts have passed by and the existence is unknown. "
“The area where you step directly is because there is ferocious animal excrement on the ground, and biological instinct is to choose a safe area to excrete, so it means there is no excessive danger or cannibalistic quagmire. "
"As for the scope of the detour, it's because of the wild ghost's nose. His nose is sensitive and he can smell the smell of dangerous beasts. You will learn a lot along the way. Memorize as many as you can. "
When Xu Qing heard this, he glanced at Mangui, who also turned his head and grinned at Xu Qing.
"As for this mud, it is a place that our team discovered many years ago that contains night lizard skin lesions. Applying it all over the body will not only cover our aura, but also provide a certain deterrent. "
"Going forward is the direction we want to go, and heading north, there is the Poison Dragon Pond. The restricted jungle has been divided into several areas by scavengers spontaneously due to different landforms. "
“Poison Dragon Pond is one of them, but we won’t go there this time. "Lei Dui had already finished smearing it as he spoke.
Xu Qing had finished at this moment. When he got up, Cross walked past him. Although he questioned Xu Qing's following yesterday, he still said it with a cold face.
"Pay attention to your alienation points. The restricted area is rich in alienation. You must always pay attention. Once the alienation exceeds the standard, no one can save it. "
Xu Qing nodded, already aware of this.
He could feel that the concentration of heterogeneity in this restricted area was extremely high, but it was much weaker than when the city ruins were at their peak.
It's just that he has accumulated a lot of heterogeneity in himself now, so even if he is not practicing at this moment, just breathing, the alienation points on his arms are starting to tingle faintly.
So he took out a piece of white pill and put it in his mouth. Instead of swallowing it, he held it in his mouth and let it melt slowly.
Soon, everyone finished applying, looked at each other, and moved on.
But it was a little different from the previous journey. On the next road, their speed was slower, and everyone took out weapons in their hands.
Xu Qing swept their weapons.
The barbarian ghost is a steel shield and mace, the Lei team is a gauntlet, the cross is a long bow, and Luan Ya takes out a serrated dagger with a cold light on it.
A few days ago, Xu Qing went out to keep an eye on Pang Shan, and there were other gains as well.
Because of his keen hearing, he heard a lot of conversations among the scavengers and learned a lot of information that he had never known before.
For example, weapons, he now knows, are divided into magic weapons, talisman treasures and heavy treasures.
Among them, the magic weapon is a legendary thing and quite rare.
It is rumored that each magic weapon has varying degrees of heterogeneous pollution, which will increase with use and is extremely difficult to remove. Therefore, it is basically a non-renewable resource. In addition, it is extremely powerful, so it is naturally extremely precious.
As a result, a special type of treasure breeder was born. They were often raised in captivity from children and used their bodies to dilute the heterogeneity of the magic weapon.
This was also said by the Lei team at the beginning.
In addition to magic weapons, there are also talismans and heavy treasures.
Although the former talisman is also rare, compared to the magic weapon, it is still a luxury. As for the latter's heavy treasure, it is common.
They are often made of special materials and are weapons that ordinary people can use.
Xu Qing felt that his iron sign might be a valuable treasure, and the ones in the hands of the people in front of him were obviously of this type.
Time passed slowly, Xu Qing followed the Thunder team and gradually moved further and further into the restricted area.
We also encountered some minor troubles along the way, but most of them were dealt with by Barbarian Ghost alone.
Occasionally, when you encounter a stronger beast, the crossbow will activateShoot out.
As for Luan Ya's attacks, they are mainly based on magic. She seems to be able to perform some kind of shock, making the incoming ferocious beasts freeze, which is very inflexible.
During this period, Xu Qing also took action once, grabbing a venomous snake that was shooting from behind and crushing it directly.
After dealing with this and finding that Xu Qing could follow him from beginning to end without making any novice mistakes, he looked at Xu Qing cross-eyed, less scrutinizing, and imparted some experience to him.
"Kid, this restricted area may seem dangerous, but for those of us who crawl around here, as long as we don't encounter three situations, it's basically safe."
"You have to keep these three situations in mind."
"The first is when strange beasts from deep inside the restricted area come to the outer area. This situation is not very common, and the range of our activities is actually just outside the restricted area."
"But once we encounter it, it is extremely dangerous, because we only know the habits and abilities of the alien beasts outside, and the restricted area is too big. There are many kinds of alien beasts inside, and their abilities are also varied. If you are not careful, you will die."
"The second one is singing." At this point, Crossface showed fear.
"There is a rumor circulating in the restricted area here. It is said that singing will appear here, and only one person will hear the singing. It's just that I have never heard singing. The only one among us who has heard singing is Lei Dui."
Xu Qing looked at Captain Lei.
Team Lei didn't speak, but looked up at the depths of the penalty area, with a hint of complexity in his eyes.
"Let me tell you the third one." Luan Ya smiled and glanced at Xu Qing.
"Child, the third danger here is very common, and that is the fog."
"When the fog comes out, it's like a person becomes blind, and he will definitely get lost, and the fog usually lasts for a long time. Once you lose your way here, you can't get out in time, and you are trapped in the restricted area. With the corrosion of heterogeneity, your own heterogeneity will naturally gradually increase, and this often represents the coming of death.
"But there are two ways to resolve it, one is fire, and the other is a person with strong mental power who is born or acquired. "
"The former treats the symptoms but not the root cause. Although fire can dispel the fog in a small area and restore vision, the fog is strange and the fire cannot last forever. As for the latter, one and a half people can often appear in the camp for decades. Most of these people leave quickly and have better development. "
